specs.title: RDMA Push Initiator
specs.notes: 16/17 aligned (94%). SC-004 (telemetry <5% overhead benchmark) is an acknowledged open task recorded in the spec itself, not silent drift.

specs.title: RDMA Remote Lookup Initiator
specs.notes: Old passive-responder design (inbound listener/session/handshake/binary batch protocol). Deliberately removed in the rework into an outbound push initiator. All requirements obsolete by design; a few low-level primitives linger in rdma.rs (see unspecced).

unspecced.suggested_spec: implement loopback test or drop feature

conflicts.description: Role inversion: 001 defines a passive inbound responder; 002 defines an outbound push initiator for the same component. Resolved by supersession, but 001 lacks its own superseded banner.

recommendations: Archive spec-001 or add a SUPERSEDED banner; it accounts for the entire not-implemented count.
Decide fate of 001-era primitives (RdmaListener, send/recv, unsignaled write): relocate to remote-lookup or remove.
Resolve the empty integration-test feature and correct the README's stale #[ignore] HW-test claim.
Add a Criterion benchmark to close SC-004 (telemetry overhead).
No code changes required for spec-002 alignment.
